recommendation: Registry operations are correctly classified as operational support (600-series scope), but three findings challenge standalone viability: (1) Core registry artifacts already exist — created without 600-series lane. (2) Registry bleeds into analytics (300 reporting) and certification (800 input) — mandatory cross-lane dependencies. (3) S725 has no dedicated registry-maintenance row. If reactivated, 600 must add Row 26+ to the Ownership Matrix, resolve build_master_registry.js coexistence, and establish the '600 maintains index/ledger; build script maintains master registry' boundary.
